61235-peter-and-alexis-the-romance-of-pe.title: The Romance Of Peter The Great
61235-peter-and-alexis-the-romance-of-pe.creator: Dmitri Merejkowski
61235-peter-and-alexis-the-romance-of-pe.description: A book by Dmitri Merejkowski. No one who knows Merejkowski personally, no one who reads his story with a fair mind, will imagine for a moment that it is written to please or to amuse the “young person.” It is intended for men and women. It is a simple and earnest psychological study of the most moving episode in the life of the greatest of the Romanoff princes.

arxiv-2106-14747.title: One-Shot Affordance Detection
arxiv-2106-14747.creator: Hongchen Luo, Wei Zhai, Jing Zhang, Yang Cao, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2106-14747.description: Abstract Affordance detection refers to identifying the potential action possibilities of objects in an image, which is an important ability for robot perception and manipulation. To empower robots with this ability in unseen scenarios, we consider the challenging one-shot affordance detection problem in this paper, i.e.

arxiv-2203-05084.title: IncShrink: Architecting Efficient Outsourced Databases using Incremental MPC and Differential Privacy DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: SIGMOD ’22: International Conference on Management of Data; June 12–17, 2022; Philadelphia, PA Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06
arxiv-2203-05084.creator: Chenghong Wang, Johes Bater, Kartik Nayak, Ashwin Machanavajjhala
arxiv-2203-05084.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider secure outsourced growing databases that support view-based query answering. These databases allow untrusted servers to privately maintain a materialized view, such that they can use only the materialized view to process query requests instead of accessing the original data from which the view was derived.

arxiv-2404-19400.title: The strong CP problem revisited and solved by the gauge group topology
arxiv-2404-19400.creator: F. Strocchi
arxiv-2404-19400.description: Abstract We exploit the non-perturbative result that the θ \theta angle which defines the vacuum structure is not a c c -number free parameter, as suggested by the instanton semi-classical approximation, but instead one of the points of the spectrum of the central operator θ o ​ p \theta_{op} which describes the gauge group topology.

arxiv-2408-00309.title: Discretizing Continuous Action Space with Unimodal Probability Distributions for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2408-00309.creator: Yuanyang Zhu, Zhi Wang, Yuanheng Zhu, Chunlin Chen, Dongbin Zhao
arxiv-2408-00309.description: Abstract For on-policy reinforcement learning, discretizing action space for continuous control can easily express multiple modes and is straightforward to optimize. However, without considering the inherent ordering between the discrete atomic actions, the explosion in the number of discrete actions can possess undesired properties and induce a higher variance for the policy gradient estimator.

arxiv-2501-18216.title: Behavior Modeling Space Reconstruction for E-Commerce Search
arxiv-2501-18216.creator: Yejing Wang, Chi Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao, Qidong Liu, Maolin Wang, Xuetao Wei, Zitao Liu, Xing Shi, Xudong Yang, Ling Zhong, Wei Lin
arxiv-2501-18216.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yejing Wang, Chi Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao, Qidong Liu, Maolin Wang, Xuetao Wei, Zitao Liu, Xing Shi, Xudong Yang, Ling Zhong, Wei Lin. Delivering superior search services is crucial for enhancing customer experience and driving revenue growth in e-commerce. Conventionally, search systems model user behaviors by combining user preference and query-item relevance statically, often through a fixed logical ‘and’ relationship.

arxiv-2502-12833.title: Analysis of a household-scale model for the invasion of Wolbachia into a resident mosquito population
arxiv-2502-12833.creator: Abby Barlow, Sarah Penington, Ben Adams
arxiv-2502-12833.description: Abstract In areas infested with Aedes aegypti mosquitoes it may be possible to control dengue, and some other vector-borne diseases, by introducing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes into the wildtype population. Thus far, empirical and theoretical studies of Wolbachia release have tended to focus on the dynamics at the community scale. However, Ae.

arxiv-2504-14239.title: InfiGUI-R1: Advancing Multimodal GUI Agents from Reactive Actors to Deliberative Reasoners
arxiv-2504-14239.creator: Yuhang Liu, Pengxiang Li, Congkai Xie, Xavier Hu, Xiaotian Han, Shengyu Zhang, Hongxia Yang, Fei Wu
arxiv-2504-14239.description: Abstract . Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have powered Graphical User Interface (GUI) Agents, showing promise in automating tasks on computing devices. Recent works have begun exploring reasoning in GUI tasks with encouraging results. However, many current approaches rely on manually designed reasoning templates, which may result in reasoning that is not sufficiently robust and adaptive for complex GUI environments.

arxiv-2504-15575.title: Exploring the User Experience of AI-Assisted Sound Searching Systems for Creative Workflows
arxiv-2504-15575.creator: Haohe Liu 1 , Thomas Deacon 1 , Wenwu Wang 1 , Matt Paradis 2 , Mark D. Plumbley 1
arxiv-2504-15575.description: Abstract Locating the right sound effect efficiently is an important yet challenging topic for audio production. Most current sound-searching systems rely on pre-annotated audio labels created by humans, which can be time-consuming to produce and prone to inaccuracies, limiting the efficiency of audio production.

arxiv-2507-17439.title: Doubly robust outlier-resistant inference on causal treatment effect Journal: Computational Statistics and Data Analysis
arxiv-2507-17439.creator: Juhyun Park, Byeonghee Lee, Saebom Jeon, Joonsung Kang
arxiv-2507-17439.description: Abstract Outliers can severely distort causal effect estimation in observational studies, yet this issue has received limited attention in the literature. Their influence is especially pronounced in small sample sizes, where detecting and removing outliers becomes increasingly difficult. Therefore, it is essential to estimate treatment effects robustly without excluding these influential data points.

arxiv-2511-01433.title: CG-FKAN: Compressed-Grid Federated Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks for Communication Constrained Environment Thanks: This research was partly supported by the Institute of Information & Communications Technology Planning & Evaluation (IITP)-ITRC (Information Technology Research Center) grant funded by th
arxiv-2511-01433.creator: Seunghun Yu, Youngjoon Lee, Jinu Gong, Joonhyuk Kang
arxiv-2511-01433.description: Abstract Federated learning (FL), widely used in privacy-critical applications, suffers from limited interpretability, whereas Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks (KAN) address this limitation via learnable spline functions. However, existing FL studies applying KAN overlook the communication overhead introduced by grid extension, which is essential for modeling complex functions.

arxiv-2512-19277.title: Active diffusing crystals in a 2D non-equilibrium system
arxiv-2512-19277.creator: Ashley Z. Guo, Sam Wilken, Dov Levine, Paul M. Chaikin
arxiv-2512-19277.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ashley Z. Guo, Sam Wilken, Dov Levine, Paul M. Chaikin. We investigate a 2D dynamical absorbing state model of monodisperse disks, in which rich phase behavior arises from interactions consisting solely of repulsive displacements between overlapping particles.

arxiv-2601-14141.title: Symmetry Breaking and Phase Transitions in Random Non-Commutative Geometries and Related Random-Matrix Ensembles
arxiv-2601-14141.creator: Mauro D’Arcangelo, Sven Gnutzmann
arxiv-2601-14141.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mauro D’Arcangelo, Sven Gnutzmann. Ensembles of random fuzzy non-commutative geometries may be described in terms of finite ( N 2 N^{2} -dimensional) Dirac operators and a probability measure. Dirac operators of type ( p , q ) (p,q) are defined in terms of commutators and anti-commutators of 2 p + q − 1 2^{p+q-1} hermitian matrices H k H_{k} and tensor products with a representation of a Clifford algebra.

plos-pone-0011336.creator: Jaap D. van Buul, Jos van Rijssel, Floris P. J. van Alphen et al.
plos-pone-0011336.description: PLOS ONE research article. During transendothelial migration, leukocytes use adhesion molecules, such as ICAM-1, to adhere to the endothelium. ICAM-1 is a dynamic molecule that is localized in the apical membrane of the endothelium and clusters upon binding to leukocytes. However, not much is known about t

pmc-10736301.title: ADVANCE CARE PLANNING ACROSS SOCIODEMOGRAPHIC CHARACTERISTICS AND COGNITION LEVELS
pmc-10736301.creator: Zahra Rahemi, Swann Adams
pmc-10736301.description: Older adults from underrepresented and minority groups have higher rates of chronic disease and cognitive impairment and lower rates of advance care planning and comfort care at the end of life. This study examined advance care planning in U.S. older adults across different sociodemographic characteristics and cognition levels. Secondary data analyses were conducted using the 2014 Health and Retirement Study.

pmc-11678855.title: Thermal, Molecular Dynamics, and Mechanical Properties of Poly(Ethylene Furanoate)/Poly(ε-Caprolactone) Block Copolymers
pmc-11678855.creator: Johan Stanley, Panagiotis A. Klonos, Aikaterini Teknetzi, Nikolaos Rekounas, Apostolos Kyritsis, Lidija Fras Zemljič, Dimitra A. Lambropoulou, Dimitrios N. Bikiaris
pmc-11678855.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study presents the synthesis and characterization of a series of multiblock copolymers, poly(ethylene 2,5-furandicarboxylate)-poly(ε-caprolactone) (PEF-PCL), created through a combination of the two-step melt polycondensation method and ring opening polymerization, as sustainable alternatives to fossil-based plastics. The structural confirmation of these block copolymers was achieved through Attenuated Total Reflectance Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (ATR-FTIR), ensuring the successful integration of PEF and PCL segments.

pmc-12468947.title: Cardiovascular Health, Assessed by Life’s Essential 8, Is Associated with Lower Risk of Disability Among Older, Community-Dwelling Men and Women
pmc-12468947.creator: Xin Li, Yichen Jin, Stefania Bandinelli, Luigi Ferrucci, Toshiko Tanaka, Sameera A. Talegawkar
pmc-12468947.description: Our study examined the associations between overall cardiovascular health (CVH) and the risk of disability in older adults over 16 years of follow-up. Data from the InCHIANTI study were used and included 928 participants aged 65 years and older. Overall CVH was measured using the “Life’s Essential 8” (LE8) metric.

pmc-12473266.title: A Hybrid Model Based on a Dual-Attention Mechanism for the Prediction of Remaining Useful Life of Aircraft Engines
pmc-12473266.creator: Chenwen He, Zixiang Li, Chenyu Zheng, Zikai Zhang, Liping Zhang, Jiawei Xiang
pmc-12473266.description: Estimating the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of aircraft engines plays a vital role in the field of prognostics and health management. In multi-dimensional time series regression tasks, accurately capturing both time series features and sensor features, as well as integrating these two types of features, poses a significant challenge for RUL prediction.

pmc-12499507.title: Repositioning Antimicrobial Peptides Against WHO‐Priority Fungi
pmc-12499507.creator: Cesar Augusto Roque‐Borda, Kaila Petronila Medina‐Alarcón, João Paulo Soler Gonçalves Pereira, Thais Cristina dos Anjos Sevilhano, Brigitte Aguilar‐Morón, Fernando Díaz‐Cárdenas, Lucas Silva da Cruz, Francisco Humberto Xavier‐Júnior, Eduardo Festozo Vicente, João Perdigão, Beatriz G. de la Torre, Fe
pmc-12499507.description: The growing threat of fungal infections, particularly in immunocompromised individuals, is exacerbated by the limited number of antifungal drug classes, increasing resistance rates, and complex hostpathogen interactions. In response to this public health concern, the World Health Organization published its first list of fungal priority pathogens, including C. auris, A. fumigatus, C. neoformans, and C. albicans.

pmc-13277180.title: Divided-and-combined association test for pleiotropic effects with GWAS summary statistics
pmc-13277180.creator: Boheng Hu, Yaoyao Chen, Xueqin Zheng, Hongping Guo
pmc-13277180.description: Many genome-wide association studies (GWAS) conducted over the past two decades have focused on testing the one-to-one association between genetic variants and complex diseases or phenotypes. Despite their considerable success, such one-to-one testing approaches are underpowered because they do not utilize information on pleiotropic effects. Currently available public GWAS summary statistics provide resources for multi-trait association testing.

pmc-13334450.title: Delayed Diagnosis of Pulmonary‐Renal Syndrome Presenting as Chronic Hemoptysis Leading to ESRD
pmc-13334450.creator: Kalie Nuss, Katiana Garagozlo, Lilliana Barillas-Arias, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13334450.description: This case demonstrates the importance of recognizing the various presentations of MPA in pediatric patients and highlights the need for more documentation and discussion of MPA in the current literature in order to increase awareness of MPA and provide possible basis for future diagnostic criteria. MPA is known to primarily affect the kidneys and present with a variety of symptoms.

pmc-13435948.title: Long-term trends in age at psychiatric admission (2006–2022): influence of sex, diagnosis, and admission type in a single Italian catchment
pmc-13435948.creator: Tommaso Barlattani, Federico Salfi, Valentina Socci, Giulio Renzi, Antony Bologna, Silvia Tamanti, Edoardo Trebbi, Alessandro Rossi, Ferdinando Romano, Francesca Pacitti
pmc-13435948.description: AimsFollowing Italy’s psychiatric reform, national inpatient numbers declined, but how the age at admission has changed across sex, diagnostic, and admission-type subgroups remains unclear. This study examined 17 consecutive years (2006–2022) of psychiatric admissions to the sole ward serving L’Aquila, assessing temporal trends in age at admission by diagnosis, sex, and admission status (voluntary vs. compulsory).

pmc-13556830.title: 383. Reinstatement of escitalopram and clonidine administration reverse the discontinuation-induced rebound firing activity of rat norepinephrine and serotonin neurons
pmc-13556830.creator: P Blier, N Okamoto, M El Mansari
pmc-13556830.description: BackgroundA selective serotonin (5-HT) reuptake inhibitors (SSRI) discontinuation syndrome has been well documented following their abrupt cessation, especially with medications that have a shorter half-life than fluoxetine [Rosenbaum et al, 1998]. These symptoms may include worsened mood, irritability, agitation, dizziness, confusion headaches, nervousness, and sensation of electrical shocks.

pmc-13619481.title: The mechanism linking self-determined motivation to pickleball continuance intention: mediating role of leisure specialization and gender heterogeneity
pmc-13619481.creator: Yajun Wu, Zhidong Dai, Soohyun Kim, Xin Lyu, Kailin Zhong
pmc-13619481.description: Integrating Self-Determination Theory (SDT) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), this study examines how self-determined motivation (autonomy, competence, relatedness) shapes continuance intention among pickleball participants, with leisure specialization conceptualized as a domain-specific operationalization of perceived behavioral control (PBC). The mediating role of leisure specialization and the moderating effect of gender on the underlying motivational pathways are tested.
